column2: [intro]
On social media, it's a battleground of hate,
Everyone has their say, even stones take the stage.
But I’d rather make hearts dance,
On light notes, forgetting all the mischance.
All the opinions, all the opinions, they can drive you mad,
We love to grumble, criticize, it's the chaos we’ve had.
But I say, I say, peace and love for all,
Let’s tolerate and celebrate, it’s so much more cool.
I’ve got friends telling me what to think,
But in my head, I’d rather let it all sink.
The world’s much brighter when we’re free,
From judgment’s chains, we can be truly carefree.
All the opinions, all the opinions, they don't matter much,
My radiant smile leaves them out of touch.
You can’t please everyone, that’s well-known,
So let’s dance, let’s sing, and be proud of our own.
[ solo ]
All the opinions, all the opinions, it’s so much fun,
I’m me, you’re you, we’re different, we’ve won.
In diversity, there’s so much to share,
Let’s dance together, laugh together, enjoy the freedom we bear.
[outro]
